notes.title: Mirror Angel's Paradise 25% Off for the Steam Winter 2018 Sales!
notes.content:
Hey Guys Good Morning!

If you've been on the fence about challenging the ruthless and concerningly self-reflective tower of BABIL then now's your chance to pick up this GOTY bullet hell dungeon rogue Enter The Gungeon-like super game.

I appreciate the feedback and support I've received from those who've tried out the game and I look forward to hearing from more people about Mirror Angel's Paradise!

Remember if you aren't willing to pay the price tag there's always a free demo available if you're curious to see what MAP is about.

Thanks lads, Henez

notes.title: Mirror Angel's Paradise now available!
notes.content: Both the full game and demo are available to play. I hope you enjoy!
